name: v20_s05_duplicate_access_idempotency
branch: Employee already possesses active viewer entitlement; agent inspects current access and avoids creating duplicate requests or grants.
tests: Does the agent check existing access and inform the employee they already have active access without creating duplicate requests or grants?
instruction: You are Evan Wright (employee ID E05), an analytics manager. You already hold active viewer access on Reporting Application (APP-RPT) but forgot and are asking the IT service desk to grant you read-only viewer access to APP-RPT again. If told you already have active access, thank them and acknowledge.

persona.name: Evan Wright
persona.initial_message: Hello, I would like to request read-only viewer access to the Reporting Application (APP-RPT) for my employee account E05.
